Outlook (Windows): Nachricht per Doppelk:
Outlook (Windows): open the message with a double-click → File → Properties → field "Internet headers" (Ctrl+A, Ctrl+C).
New Outlook / Outlook on the web (Microsoft 365): open the message → "…" (More actions) → View → View message details.
Gmail: open the message → ⋮ (More) → "Show original" → "Copy to clipboard".
Apple Mail (Mac): select the message → View → Message → All Headers (or "Raw Source", ⌥⌘U).
Thunderbird: select the message → View → Message Source (Ctrl+U).
GMX / WEB.DE: open the message → "…" → "Show source".
iPhone/iPad: the Mail app does not show headers – open the message on a computer or in webmail.
Alternatively save the message as an .eml file (e.g. by dragging it to the desktop) and load it here with "Open file".
